ceiling_directive: Prove an adaptive informativeness frontier for the optimizer confidence set on the published Song et al. model specialization: root-n Hausdorff contraction on stable faces with a matching lower bound, while retaining honest containment over the full categorical-IV class.
improvement_directive: Strengthen the confidence-fiber theorem with a sharp contraction result on stable faces and matching lower bound. Replace the global separation of every response-fiber basis in the root-n theorem with conditions involving only locally reachable optimal bases.
critique: The advertised full population correspondence is obtained by composing the published finite response-type fiber with a standard finite minimax-regret program; the pure-rule and rectangle-preservation equivalences are KKT and feasibility certificates rather than a new identification frontier. The substantive limit theorem applies only after imposing separation of every nonsingular response basis, a unique primal-dual solution, and rank, slack, reduced-cost, and active-weight margins, and it supplies no informative inference result beyond that preselected regular face. The Bonferroni construction proves exact containment but gives no diameter, contraction rate, or optimality guarantee, while the irregularity theorem establishes impossibility only through one singleton-identified full-compliance submodel. The framing accurately limits the Gaussian and face-intersection claims, but what is proved remains a narrow regular-face sensitivity result, an exact witness, and conservative set containment rather than a field-level inference frontier.
